reviews.text: Hi, I've known this agency for a long time. I've just started a new job with Zero Zero Sitter. They have a lot of job opportunities. Highly recommended.
Very nice and I recommend that you continue joining this agency. Blessings.
I had a wonderful experience. I found work right away with this agency.

We turned to Zero Zero Sitter to find a nanny for my grandchildren and were very happy with the service. They immediately understood our needs and helped us find the right person quickly. Professional, helpful, and very efficient: I recommend them!
Excellent agency, serious and reliable. Serena was very professional during the interview process and helped me find a job quickly.

Excellent experience with Zero Zero Sitter. I quickly found a great housekeeper, thanks to the staff's helpfulness and professionalism. I particularly appreciated the option of video conferencing, which was very convenient since I wasn't in Milan. I definitely recommend the service!
Very good and professional
Very very serious, reliable agency.💯💯💯 …

Very helpful and problem-solving people...
Very professional...
Excellent organizational skills.
Failed search

What can I say, I didn't think it was that simple.

After submitting an online application on the website, three resumes immediately arrived that were absolutely relevant to the request. These were excellent candidates; it was hard to choose!

Zero Zero Sitter is a very, very reliable agency. I personally have 15 years of experience with them. Ms. Serena and her staff are very reliable and demonstrate professionalism and reliability!!!
Good luck to everyone!

Hi, my name is Barbara.
I've been working with the zero zero Sitter agency for over 10 years, and I must say I've always been very satisfied. They're a reliable agency that quickly finds work.
The job offers they send are also written clearly and transparently. I highly recommend this agency to everyone!
A professional and competent agency specializing in the selection of family caregivers. They understand your needs and are thorough in checking references.

Great experience! I chose Zero Zero Sitter on the recommendation of a friend. I needed someone trustworthy and meticulous to take care of my home, since I work a lot, and I couldn't have asked for better. Only carefully selected and, above all, reliable staff. Highly recommended!

I thank and highly recommend Zero Zero Sitter. We needed a nanny urgently, and Serena, with her professionalism and empathy, was able to provide us with solutions in a very short time! If we need anything else in the future, we will definitely contact her again!

We had a great experience with Zero Zero Sitter.
We greatly appreciated their professionalism, speed, and above all, their ability to listen: from the beginning, they perfectly understood our needs and only offered us people who truly fit our needs.

The service also includes detailed and precise resumes, allowing for a clear and objective analysis of the proposed profiles.
A serious, efficient, and attentive agency: we recommend them without hesitation. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Staff unsuitable for a service involving the recruitment of minors and the elderly, therefore protected categories.
They threaten nannies and invent,
they defame online, and they arrange appointments without warning.
There are better options on the market.
Great experience.

I want to share my experience with the Zero Zero Sitter employment agency, especially with the kindness shown to me by Mrs. Melania. I thank her infinitely for the help I received in finding my new job. If I need help in the future, I know who to turn to.
I can only recommend my acquaintances to contact and ask for Mrs. Melania. Thank you, Adela.
Seriousness, speed and reliability

I worked with Melania.
I had never used an agency to find a babysitter, and since I was in Milan for work, I needed someone to watch my two-and-a-half-year-old son for about eight hours on a Saturday. Unlike other agencies, Zero Zero Sitter had already provided me with a few names in just a couple of hours. I asked them for help at the last minute, and we had very few days to finalize a candidate. Despite already having a good number of resumes, Melania, not feeling completely at ease, sent me more. Furthermore, she immediately put me in touch, allowing a video interview, demonstrating immense trust in me (I don't know how many would have done so without knowing me).
She is a sensitive, super helpful, understanding person, and despite being very busy with other requests, she never gave me a sign that she wanted to rush her work with me.
Professionalism is hard to find.
Thank you so much for everything.
I had a very good time
Serena was a great help in finding us a wonderful nanny for our children.

This agency offers various types of work as a housekeeper and caregiver (part-time and full-time). It's well-known in Milan and the surrounding area. Serena and her colleagues manage the job search, making it easy and discreet. I'm truly satisfied.
They're great and super kind! If you're looking for work, trust them. I found a wonderful family. Thank you so much.

We contacted them for a rather complicated request for a transfer to Sardinia. They worked tirelessly and tirelessly, despite the difficult time of year (it was just around Christmas time). We especially thank Serena, who did an excellent job, always suggesting highly qualified personnel options that met our needs. I highly recommend working with them; you won't be disappointed!
I sincerely thank this agency because it is a very helpful agency, and above all in a short time my husband and I found work as a couple, it was exactly what we wanted. Thank you ❤️
They are the best, they are attentive, thank you Melania, Serena and Barbara, it is a pleasure working with you, thanks again.

The experience was nonexistent, just like the service, and therefore very negative. Immediately after receiving the application fee (€150), two "friends" were sent to us, completely uninterested in the job, simply to prove that the search had been done, and then collect the fee (a small amount, but when multiplied by multiple people, it starts to add up) and then literally disappear for three weeks. Before receiving the money, Melania texted me twice a day. Then came silence. And then the excuse that they hadn't found anyone at the conditions offered (it's a shame the conditions were clear before the decision to take the job), all of which, I repeat, was aimed at collecting the application fee.
You'll hear that the terms you're asking for are too low for the market, a shame that this only serves to justify this agency's total inability to deliver on its promises.
Unfortunately, in the babysitting market in Milan, these agencies, or rather, this agency, thrives due to the total lack of controls and regulations.
Not only should it not be used, but it should also be prosecuted.
Thank you, we don't know who you are.. but thank you!
Thanks Roberto!!
High professionalism
Thanks Giovanna!
A service dedicated to those dearest to us, managed with professionalism and courtesy.
